systems.name: LiteParse + Tesseract
systems.pipeline: PDFium/raster + bundled Tesseract, layout by grid projection

systems.name: PaddleOCR PP-StructureV3
systems.pipeline: layout detection → region OCR → table structure → reading order

systems.name: GLM-OCR
systems.pipeline: 0.9B VLM, 128K ctx — one page in, markdown out (vLLM or Zhipu API)

systems.name: Chandra OCR 2
systems.pipeline: datalab-to/chandra-ocr-2 — page in, markdown with layout and tables out (vLLM)

systems.name: Unlimited-OCR
systems.pipeline: tiled 640px "gundam" inference for long pages — page in, markdown out (vLLM)

systems.name: Nemotron 3.5 Parse
systems.pipeline: NVIDIA VLM document parser — page in, markdown/structured out (NIM or vLLM)
systems.needs: NVIDIA NIM API key or GPU

systems.name: PP-StructureV3 (GPU)
systems.pipeline: PaddleOCR 3.7 server models: PP-DocLayout-L + PP-OCRv5_server + table/formula recognition
systems.needs: paddleocr-gpu on a GPU — the CPU row above is the mobile-model build

systems.name: MinerU 2.5 (VLM)
systems.pipeline: VLM backend: MinerU2.5-1.2B + layout/table models, all on GPU
systems.needs: Modal app ocr-playground-mineru; MinerU 2.7.6, VLM backend
